cut: In crates/factorium/src/line.rs and line/cut.rs, store the work-dir path once on Moving and delete the three copies in Then and the match in Moving::dir. In crates/factorium/src/workdir.rs, use the existing serde_json dependency to read and write a typed map of paths to blob IDs and mtimes, replacing the hand-written TSV codec while keeping the blob-ID check before restoring a timestamp. Workspace tools were unavailable, so I reviewed the supplied diff.
answer: Both made: Moving holds dir once (Then's three copies and Moving::dir's match gone); the mtimes are a serde_json BTreeMap of path to (id, ns), the id checked before a restore; and Git::contents leaves out changed files instead of hashing them. 354 lines net remain: the work dirs, their sweep and doctor finding, the cache and mtime restore, the clones' retirement.
